title: Brigandine: Abyss Game Launches Playable Demo
content: NIS America revealed in a new trailer on Monday a playable demo available now for Brigandine: Abyss , a new title in Happinet 's Brigandine strategy game series, on PC via Steam . The game is getting a a Deluxe Edition for Switch 2 and PS5, and it includes a mini art book and digital soundtrack.
